positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed in the Supply Chain Data and Analytics team to enable visibility across the supply chain of products such as Xbox and Surface
• Integrated multiple data sources within a single platform, and Automated weekly reports to monitor the usage of multiple key performance indicators of my organization, like databases, services and users in the last 52 weeks, with Azure Cubes, Azure Logs, Kusto and MySQL
• Provided query and user level visibility with PowerBI on the usage of all our tables across multiple databases, and assisted on the efforts of detecting and removing hundreds of unused tables across our databases in the Azure MySQL Server of my organization
• Debugged and refactored my team's production systems and data pipelines covering a wide range of business cases with .NET & Azure
positions.insights: C#, Microsoft Power BI and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed & deployed an internal web application for automation and self-service establishment of data flows from the Core Finance team's data lakes to multiple internal teams located in different departments
	•	Builded the front-end with React & JavaScript following the MVC design pattern, connected with the back-end using a REST API & ASP.NET
	•	Tested the whole UI with a new front-end framework that met accessibility and consistency requirements of Microsoft products
	•	Implemented account management and authentication for employees with Azure Active Directory

projects.title: Sentinel - Data analysis platform for Twitter
projects.description:
Web app for statistical and sentiment analysis for tweets in Mexico.
• Reports generated in real time by search or periodical subscription
• Statistics report with interactive charts and maps
• Front-end developed with React & Typescript, hosted in Heroku
• Back-end developed with NodeJS and Express

projects.title: Waste Tracker - Android app
projects.description:
Mobile app for the reduction of waste generation in homes.
• Waste type identification with an image recognition machine learning model
• Calculate individual yearly waste production from a questionnaire
• Developed with Kotlin in Android Studio
